records.label: spacr.qt.i18n.ui_language_resolved_once#1
records.source: :func:`current_language` reaches into ``QSettings`` on every call, and a dialog build calls it once per :func:`tr`. Building Preferences was measured asking the preference store what language the interface was in **346 times**, through 415 ``QSettings`` reads, for one dialog; the Mask screen's panel build had the same shape at 3,516.
records.context: :func:`current_language` reaches into ``QSettings`` on every call, and a dialog build calls it once per :func:`tr`. Building Preferences was measured asking the preference store what language the interface was in **346 times**, through 415 ``QSettings`` reads, for one dialog; the Mask application view's panel build had the same shape at 3,516.
records.translation: :func:`current_language` sækir í ``QSettings`` í hverju kalli, og bygging glugga kallar á það einu sinni fyrir hvert :func:`tr`. Mælt var að bygging Preferences spurði stillingageymsluna hvaða tungumál viðmótið væri á **346 sinnum**, gegnum 415 ``QSettings`` lestra, fyrir einn glugga; spjaldbygging Mask-skjásins hafði sömu lögun við 3,516.

records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.PreferencesDialog#1
records.source: Kept as a factory (not a real class subclass) so this module can be imported headless without pulling in QtWidgets. The real :class:`QDialog` is returned by ``PreferencesDialog(parent)``. Build the dialog with the UI language resolved once.
records.context: Kept as a factory (not a real class subclass) so this module can be imported headless without pulling in QtWidgets. The real :class:`QDialog` is returned by ``PreferencesDialog(parent)``. Build the dialog with the UI language resolved once.
records.translation: Haldið sem verksmiðju (ekki raunverulegri undirklassa) svo að þessa einingu megi flytja inn án skjás og án þess að draga QtWidgets með. Raunverulegum :class:`QDialog` er skilað af ``PreferencesDialog(parent)``. Byggðu gluggann þar sem UI-tungumálið er leyst einu sinni.
